grades.quote: The interaction of the memory model with I/O memory, instruction fetches, FENCE.I, page table walks, and SFENCE.VMA is not (yet) formalized.
grades.reason: It only says that the memory model's interaction with instruction fetches and FENCE.I is not yet formalized. It does not say whether a local FENCE.I synchronizes instruction fetch on other harts. It does note that ordering between harts needs explicit synchronization, so it gives limited background.
It describes the hypervisor HFENCE.VVMA and HFENCE.GVMA address-translation fences. It says nothing about FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
It covers commit conditions for normal fences and fence.tso in the operational memory model. It does not cover FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization.
It covers the aq/rl ordering bits on atomic instructions. It does not mention FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
